title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
slides: What if your next team app built itself?
Google's Tabletop AI turns prompts into working apps.
But most users abandon custom tools within weeks.
Teams can now prototype without a developer.
Test one real workflow before trusting it.
thread_text:
1. Your app builds itself?

Google's Tabletop AI turns prompts into working apps. No code, no dev team—just describe what you need.

2. Prototype without a developer

Teams can spin up custom tools in minutes. The barrier to entry just dropped to zero.

3. The abandonment trap

Most users ditch custom tools within weeks. Building is easy; sticking with them isn't.

4. Test before you trust

Before rolling out to your team, run one real workflow through the AI-built app. See if it actually holds up.

5. Try it on one task

Take a single repetitive workflow and prototype it with Tabletop. If it saves time without extra edits, scale it. If not, you've lost nothing.
